parameters.content:
#### Automated Configuration and Secure Data Ingestion with Entra Application 
Clicking on "Deploy" will trigger the creation of the ZPA_CL Log Analytics table and a Data Collection Rule (DCR). 
It will then create an Entra application, link the DCR to it, and set the entered secret in the application. This setup enables data to be sent securely to the DCR using an Entra token.

properties.description: ZPAUserActivity Data Parser with template version 3.0.0

properties.query:
// Parse a ZPA timestamp field that may arrive as epoch seconds/ms/microseconds
// (Cloud NSS DCR-ingest path) or as a strftime/ISO datetime string (VM/syslog path).
let toDt = (x: dynamic) {
    case(
        isempty(tostring(x)),         datetime(null),
        strlen(tostring(x)) == 10,    datetime(1970-01-01) + tolong(x) * 1s,           // epoch seconds (Cloud NSS LogTimestamp)
        strlen(tostring(x)) == 13,    datetime(1970-01-01) + tolong(x) * 1ms,          // epoch milliseconds
        strlen(tostring(x)) == 16,    datetime(1970-01-01) + (tolong(x) / 1000) * 1ms, // epoch microseconds (Cloud NSS Timestamp*) — divide first to avoid timespan overflow
        todatetime(x))                                                                  // VM/syslog "Wed May 27 ..." or ISO 8601
};
ZPA_CL
| extend JsonStart = indexof(Message, "{")
| extend CleanMessage = iff(JsonStart >= 0, substring(Message, JsonStart), Message)
| extend ParsedData = parse_json(CleanMessage)
| where isnotnull(ParsedData.PolicyProcessingTime)
| project
    EventVendor="Zscaler",
    EventProduct="Private Access",
    LogTimestamp = toDt(ParsedData.LogTimestamp),
    Customer = tostring(ParsedData.Customer),
    SessionID = tostring(ParsedData.SessionID),
    ConnectionID = tostring(ParsedData.ConnectionID),
    InternalReason = tostring(ParsedData.InternalReason),
    ConnectionStatus = tostring(ParsedData.ConnectionStatus),
    IPProtocol = toint(ParsedData.IPProtocol),
    DoubleEncryption = toint(ParsedData.DoubleEncryption),
    Username = tostring(ParsedData.Username),
    ServicePort = toint(ParsedData.ServicePort),
    ClientPublicIP = tostring(ParsedData.ClientPublicIP),
    ClientPrivateIP = tostring(ParsedData.ClientPrivateIP),
    ClientLatitude = todouble(ParsedData.ClientLatitude),
    ClientLongitude = todouble(ParsedData.ClientLongitude),
    ClientCountryCode = tostring(ParsedData.ClientCountryCode),
    ClientZEN = tostring(ParsedData.ClientZEN),
    Policy = tostring(ParsedData.Policy),
    Connector = tostring(ParsedData.Connector),
    ConnectorZEN = tostring(ParsedData.ConnectorZEN),
    ConnectorIP = tostring(ParsedData.ConnectorIP),
    ConnectorPort = toint(ParsedData.ConnectorPort),
    Host = tostring(ParsedData.Host),
    Application = tostring(ParsedData.Application),
    AppGroup = tostring(ParsedData.AppGroup),

The Zscaler Private Access solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) logs into Microsoft Sentinel using Zscaler Cloud NSS push connectors.

Supported log types:

  1. User Activity
  2. User Status
  3. App Protection
  4. App Connector Status
  5. Private Service Edge (PSE) Status

All feeds land in the shared ZPA_CL table and are surfaced through the included parsers and workbooks.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

  1. Azure Monitor Logs: DCR-based Custom Logs
  2. Codeless Connector Platform (CCP)
